1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora de hasta 15 m de altura, de tallos delgados, hojas opuestas, oblongo-elípticas y acuminadas, inflorescencia en racimos y flores de color azul lila; es ornamental. Verbenaceae Petrea volubilis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant reaching a height of up to 15 m, with slender stems, opposite leaves that are oblong-elliptical and acuminate, inflorescence in racemes, and flowers of blue-violet color; it is ornamental. Verbenaceae Petrea volubilis.
